messages:
incident-bot: Paging: high error rate and container crashloops for runtime-service (us-west). Multiple segfaults reported in the last 3 minutes. Paging oncall.
ryan: ack, i'm oncall and looking now. what's the impacted pool?
ana: seeing repeated SIGSEGV in fused_kernel.so on p-sv-rt-3 and p-sv-rt-4. trace shows symbol from vllm_engine::dispatch()
jordan: I can grab cores. Are containers producing core dumps? ulimit shows core disabled on probes.
michelle: quick customer note: CS reporting ~5 customers affected with failing chat/embeddings, 10-15% error rate for requests hitting model=redwood-v1 in us-west.
liz (cs): customers: acme-inc, fintech-app, searchly. ACME reports 30% of chat requests get immediate 502s.
ryan: ok mitigation plan: 1) route traffic away from us-west for read-heavy endpoints 2) enable fallback model (redwood-v1-quant) 3) capture cores + debug 4) roll a config to disable fused kernels on hot nodes.
ml-runtime-bot: autoprobe: last failures: 1728456768,1728456779,1728456784. Pod logs: `runtime-engine: segfault at 0x7f8b5...`
Stack sample:
```
#0  0x00007f8b5a1f4b6 in fused_kernel::run() at fused_kernel.cpp:412
#1  0x000055b3f4d2c7f in vllm_engine::dispatch()
#2  0x000055b3f4d1a2d in main_loop()
```
ana: also seeing OOM scores increasing before segfault on some pods; could be kernel oom-priority interaction when kv cache grows.
ryan: jamming commands: first, set a quick traffic split to fallback region/us-east for api routes hitting model redwood-v1:
```
# via infra console
reroute --from us-west --to us-east --service runtime-service --percent 80
```
michelle: routing change in progress :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Routing change applied to 80% of traffic. Confirming: traffic now 20%->us-west.
ryan: next, disable fused kernel flag on node pool rollout (will configmap patch + rollout restart):
```
kubectl -n rw set env ds/runtime-service FUSED_KERNEL=false --all
kubectl -n rw rollout restart daemonset/runtime-service
```
jordan: starting core capture: enabling ulimit and gcore on the node, will scp cores to /tmp/rt-cores.
ana: also collecting `dmesg` from nodes, I see repeated "kill` messages and GPU driver warnings referencing CUDA page faults.
ml-runtime-bot: note: models using tensorRT path show higher failure correlation. Suggested temporary policy: prefer pytorch path for quantized variants.
ryan: good, also reduce batch sizes for affected model to reduce KV memory pressure. Patching config now.
michelle: batch size reduced to 1 for redwood-v1 on us-west.
liz (cs): notifying customers: sent updates to ACME and FINTECH-APP; advising degraded performance but functional fallback in us-east.
ryan: jordan, paste core backtraces when ready.
jordan: core uploaded to s3://redwood-core-dumps/1728456789/; basic backtrace: `fused_kernel::run()` crash inside `cudaMemcpyAsync`.
ana: that aligns with CUDA driver stack. Could be a driver-runtime mismatch on nodes with newer driver patch 525.x; schedule node drain
ryan: immediate action: cordon p-sv-rt-3, p-sv-rt-4 and drain; move workloads to healthy nodes. Also bump capacity in us-east to absorb traffic.
deploy-bot: cordon/drain initiated for p-sv-rt-3, p-sv-rt-4. Rolling pods to other nodes.
ml-runtime-bot: temporary fallback enabled: redwood-v1->redwood-v1-quant path; traffic split updated: 95% us-east, 5% us-west.
michelle: error rate in us-west has dropped to 2% after draining two nodes; overall platform errors decreased from 12% -> 3%.
liz (cs): customers acknowledged. ACME wants ETA for fix.
ryan: short term: keep fused kernel disabled and keep nodes cordoned. long term: reproduce locally with same driver + kernel combo, then either patch fused_kernel or revert driver. open an ENG-PLS ticket for kernel/driver reconciliation.
ana: logging ticket: RT-4128 "segfault in fused_kernel.cu on CUDA 525.x" assigned to eng-runtime.
jordan: cores show GPU memory corruption pattern; will try reproducer with smaller model next.
ryan: final operational note: we pushed a hotfix image disabling the tensorRT fused path for redwood-v1 and rolled to 100% in us-west after draining. Monitoring for 15m.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged. Severity: Sev2. Impact: partial service degradation for models in us-west, fallback routing applied. Oncall: ryan. Engineers: ana, jordan, michelle. CS contact: liz.
michelle: monitoring looks stable for 18 minutes, error rate steady 1.5%.
liz (cs): told ACME ETA 4h for root cause + permanent fix; they accepted fallback for now.
ryan: adding postmortem owners. I'll file postmortem and include timeline, cores, reproducer steps, and mitigation. Marking thread for postmortem.
anna: (typo) -> ana: closing handover to eng-runtime for root cause and patch.
ryan: closing incident thread, followups in ENG-RUNTIME channel. :white_check_mark:
